name: dsh-archive-cleanup
description: One-click cleanup for archived DSH sessions. The host half lists the Workspace registry's archive set with on-disk sizes and permanently deletes a session's artifacts (JSONL log directory, projection-cache record) while releasing its archive/workspace accounting through the public registry API — all in the same request, with no harness restart. A session the Web process still holds gets its files reclaimed, its archive entry dropped, and its browser row removed immediately through the Host's own api-session/removed frame, and the Host's session-list read is then filtered for the ids this process removed, so a refresh, a reconnect, or a panel that pulls the list again (the Context Insights page does exactly that) cannot bring the row back. A session mid-turn is deferred to the idle edge the plugin observes. The browser half follows the live archive set, so a sidebar footer chip appears the moment a session is archived (hidden again at zero) and shows the exact count, plus a confirm dialog that closes on the host's answer, a result banner, and a settings page. Archived sessions are only ever removed on an explicit, confirmed request.

scripts.test: node test/smoke.mjs && node test/routes.mjs && node test/client.mjs
